**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Madam](../persons.html#1839)
'On Nebo’s lonely Mountain' is by [Mrs Alexander](../persons.html#21), wife of the [Bishop of Derry](../persons.html#1840), and author of [Hymns for Little Children](../others.html#11) – It is one of a series of hymns on Scripture which were published separately.

I have often met with mentions of [Mr Lush](../persons.html#1838) and his family in [Bishop Patteson](../persons.html#1155)’s letters and always with great affection[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Miss Lush/ Northlands/ Hollington/ S.

Leonards-on-Sea, and postmarked Winchester 26 March 1874.

[^2]: Miss Lush’s brother the Rev.

Vicesimus Lush (1817-1882) had emigrated to New Zealand in 1850 and worked in various capacities in the Auckland region under Bishop Selwyn.

See his The Auckland Journals, 1850-63 and The Thames Journals 1868-82.
